During the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] made use of an '''executive cruiser''' to transport him across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was large, majestic, and heavily armed, but fell in [[3653 BBY]] when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Sacking of Coruscant|sacked]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
